_comment: Qiraki named-character roster, for the Bloom Wars cast-collision lint (tools/lint-cast-collision.mjs). Sourced from Qiraki_Character_Sheets_v5.md and Qiraki_Military_Era_Outline_v3.md. This is a DIFFERENT protection from the Build Brief's spoiler-lock term (tools/lint-spoiler.mjs) - that one guards a single hidden reveal word and stays untouched. This one guards against a brand-new Bloom Wars name accidentally colliding with an existing Qiraki character, so the two properties never read as conflicting if held side by side (Master Index's own 'not conflicting' condition). Full crossover (2 Sep 2026) makes species/setting/structural borrowing fair game - it does not make character-name collisions fine, which is a continuity problem, not a spoiler one.
